summary: Open Lending Corp filed an 8-K announcing a definitive merger agreement with ANV Group Holdings Ltd. and its subsidiary Lakers Acquisition Sub, Inc. Under the terms, Merger Sub will commence a tender offer for all outstanding shares of Open Lending at $3.15 per share in cash, followed by a second-step merger under DGCL Section 251(h). The offer represents a premium over the prior trading price; exact premium not stated. The board has not disclosed a recommendation in the excerpt; no advisors named. The transaction is structured as a one-step tender offer with subsequent back-end merger. The consideration is all cash. Watch for tender conditions, regulatory approvals, and potential competing bids; risk-arb focus on spread to $3.15.
